meta.description: Test vectors for safety number derivation and display

notes.purpose: Safety numbers allow users to verify identity keys out-of-band
notes.components_hashed: All four key components (Ed448, ML-DSA-65, X448, sntrup761) are included
notes.commutativity: Order of keys does not matter - same safety number regardless of which key is first
notes.display_format: 60 decimal digits in 12 groups of 5, displayed as 2 rows of 6 groups

derivation_process.step1: Hash each hybrid identity: BLAKE3(Ed448_pk || ML-DSA-65_pk || X448_pk || sntrup761_pk)
derivation_process.step5: Convert first 30 bytes to 60 decimal digits using big-endian division
